about: Terrebonne is a suburban city on the north shore of the Rivière des Mille Îles, northeast of Laval in Lanaudière. It includes the historic Île-des-Moulins and newer residential developments toward Lachenaie and La Plaine. Commuter rail and Highway 640 link it to Montréal. About 120,000 people live in Terrebonne.
seoSummary: North-shore suburb of Montréal in Lanaudière, known for historic Île-des-Moulins.
knownFor: Amalgamated Lachenaie, La Plaine, and Terrebonne
